project.name: Glide-Path LEAPS Rebalancing Strategy
project.description: Adds a RebalanceRule.GLIDE_PATH variant that gradually de-levers the LEAPS allocation as the portfolio accumulates real wealth above a risk-free hurdle. The LEAPS target weight follows an exponential decay indexed to the ratio of NAV to Rf-compounded contributed capital; a one-sided trim-only rule harvests excess into the diversified base.
project.overview: Implements the 'constant-notional' insight from the DRIFT bug as a controlled, parameterized lifecycle strategy. Core additions: GlidepathConfig dataclass in _portfolio_types.py; RebalanceRule.GLIDE_PATH enum value in leverage.py; glide_path_target_weight() pure function in _backtest_steps.py; hurdle_contributed scalar field on PortfolioState updated monthly via the recurrence Contributed_hurdle(t) = Contributed_hurdle(t-1) * (1+r_f)^(1/12) + Contribution_t; rfr_series unconditionally populated in _build_context when GLIDE_PATH; GLIDE_PATH branch in _apply_rebalance (one-sided trim) and _apply_gtt_reentry (m-adjusted seed).

data_schemas.name: GlidepathConfig
data_schemas.description: Frozen configuration for the glide-path rebalancing overlay. Placed in _portfolio_types.py alongside GttConfig. Consumed by PortfolioConfig (glide_path_config field) and by the backtest loop in _apply_rebalance. Independent of LeapsConfig (pricing engine) and GttConfig (market-timing signals).

fields.name: half_life_multiple
fields.description: NAV multiple (of hurdle-adjusted contributed capital) at which the active LEAPS weight above the floor halves. Default 2.0 — weight halves when NAV doubles contributed capital.

fields.name: floor
fields.description: Minimum LEAPS target weight at any wealth level. Prevents full de-levering. Default 0.05.

fields.name: drift_band
fields.description: LEAPS weight excess above target before a trim fires, to prevent churn. Default DRIFT_BAND_RELATIVE (0.10).

data_schemas.name: PortfolioConfig (glide_path_config extension)
data_schemas.description: Existing PortfolioConfig gains one optional field to opt into glide-path rebalancing. None preserves existing QUARTERLY/DRIFT behavior exactly. When set, __post_init__ must validate floor < w0 (leaps_fraction) and half_life_multiple > 0.

fields.name: glide_path_config
fields.description: None = glide-path disabled (existing behavior unchanged). When set, rebalance_rule must equal RebalanceRule.GLIDE_PATH; __post_init__ validates consistency.

data_schemas.name: PortfolioState (hurdle_contributed extension)
data_schemas.description: Existing PortfolioState gains one new scalar field. All mutable loop state is carried as frozen PortfolioState fields via dataclasses.replace; hurdle_contributed follows that same pattern.

fields.name: hurdle_contributed
fields.description: Running Rf-compounded contribution denominator for the NAV multiple m(t). Initialized to config.initial_nav in _build_initial_state. Updated monthly via recurrence: new = old * (1+rfr)^(1/12) + monthly_contribution. Used only when rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH.

api_contracts.name: glide_path_target_weight
api_contracts.description: Pure. Compute the target LEAPS weight for the glide-path schedule: w(m) = floor + (w0 - floor) * exp(-lambda * max(m - 1.0, 0.0)), where lambda = ln(2) / half_life_multiple. Returns w0 for m <= 1.0 (no de-levering below break-even); approaches floor as m grows. Placed alongside other pure helpers in _backtest_steps.py.

inputs.name: m
inputs.description: Current NAV multiple: total_nav / hurdle_contributed. May be < 1.0 (portfolio underwater vs Rf hurdle).

inputs.name: w0
inputs.description: Initial LEAPS weight (ctx.leaps_fraction). The full weight maintained at or below break-even.

inputs.name: floor
inputs.description: Minimum LEAPS target weight. Must be < w0.

inputs.name: half_life_multiple
inputs.description: NAV multiple at which active weight (w0 - floor) halves. Must be > 0.

api_contracts.name: _apply_contribution (hurdle_contributed update)
api_contracts.description: Existing _apply_contribution fires on is_month_end. Under GLIDE_PATH it must additionally update hurdle_contributed via the recurrence: new_hurdle = state.hurdle_contributed * (1 + inputs.rfr)^(1/12) + config.monthly_contribution. Uses inputs.rfr (the per-day annualized ^IRX rate already extracted by _extract_day_inputs). No new data dependency. Must run before _apply_rebalance reads hurdle_contributed.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Current frozen state, with state.hurdle_contributed from the previous month-end.

inputs.name: ctx
inputs.description: Immutable context providing config.monthly_contribution and config.rebalance_rule.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Per-day inputs, providing inputs.rfr (annualized decimal ^IRX rate) and inputs.is_month_end.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with hurdle_contributed updated iff is_month_end and rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH.

api_contracts.name: _apply_rebalance (GLIDE_PATH branch)
api_contracts.description: New dispatch branch inside the existing _apply_rebalance. At each month-end when RebalanceRule.GLIDE_PATH: compute m = total_nav / state.hurdle_contributed; compute target_w = glide_path_target_weight(m, ...); if current_leaps_weight > target_w + drift_band, trim LEAPS to target_w * total_val using the existing leaps_scale mechanism and redirect proceeds to base at base_target_w. One-sided cap: no top-up when current_leaps_weight <= target_w + drift_band.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Current frozen state (post-contribution, so hurdle_contributed is already updated for this month).

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Provides date, spot, rfr for LEAPS valuation and trim execution.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with leaps_scale and holdings updated iff trim fired. Unchanged if no trim.

api_contracts.name: _apply_gtt_reentry (GLIDE_PATH branch)
api_contracts.description: Existing _apply_gtt_reentry seeds the fresh LEAPS simulation with total * ctx.leaps_fraction. Under GLIDE_PATH it must instead seed with glide_path_target_weight(m_current, ...) * total, where m_current = total / state.hurdle_contributed at the re-entry date. Requires a GLIDE_PATH branch inside _apply_gtt_reentry.

inputs.name: state
inputs.description: Current frozen state at the Defensive->Long transition date, with valid hurdle_contributed.

inputs.name: inputs
inputs.description: Provides total NAV, date, spot, rfr for LEAPS contract creation.

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: New frozen state with fresh LEAPS simulation seeded at the glide-path-adjusted weight.

api_contracts.name: _build_context (rfr_series unconditional population)
api_contracts.description: Currently rfr_series in BacktestContext is only populated when use_leaps is True. GLIDE_PATH requires rfr_series unconditionally (for the hurdle recurrence). _build_context must populate rfr_series whenever config.rebalance_rule == RebalanceRule.GLIDE_PATH, regardless of use_leaps. The existing forward-fill and NaN validation must also apply in this path.

inputs.name: config
inputs.description: Portfolio config, including rebalance_rule and glide_path_config.

inputs.name: return_data
inputs.description: Return series container, including risk_free_rate (^IRX daily annualized series).

outputs.name: return
outputs.description: Fully validated context with rfr_series populated when GLIDE_PATH (even if use_leaps is False).

raises: ValueError: if rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH and rfr_series has leading NaNs before the backtest start date

features.name: glide_path_target_weight() pure function
features.description: Add pure function glide_path_target_weight(m, w0, floor, half_life_multiple) to _backtest_steps.py alongside existing pure helpers. Implements: lam = ln(2) / half_life_multiple; active_weight = (w0 - floor) * exp(-lam * max(m - 1.0, 0.0)); return floor + active_weight. Must satisfy the three key invariants: w(1.0) == w0; w(m) -> floor as m -> inf; monotone non-increasing for m >= 1.

invariants.temporal_bounds: m is a function of current-state quantities only: total_nav(t) and hurdle_contributed(t). No forward values.
invariants.accounting_oracle: w(1.0) == w0 exactly (exp term = 1.0); w(inf) = floor (exp term -> 0); w(m) in [floor, w0] for all m >= 0.

performance_requirements.notes: Scalar computation with one exp call.

property_based_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project uses pytest only; no hypothesis. Invariants verified with tabulated values across the m range.

mutation_testing.rationale_if_disabled: Project uses pytest only; no mutmut in the toolchain.

features.description: Add hurdle_contributed: float field to the PortfolioState frozen dataclass in _portfolio_types.py. Initialize to config.initial_nav in _build_initial_state. The field is always present on PortfolioState regardless of rebalance_rule; it is only written by the GLIDE_PATH branch of _apply_contribution and only read in _apply_rebalance and _apply_gtt_reentry when GLIDE_PATH is active.

invariants.temporal_bounds: hurdle_contributed(t) is a function of contributions and rfr through t only. No forward values.
invariants.accounting_oracle: Recurrence: hurdle(t) = hurdle(t-1) * (1+rfr_t)^(1/12) + contribution_t. After N months from initial_nav I with monthly contribution C and constant rfr r_f, hurdle = I*(1+r_f)^(N/12) + C * sum_{k=0}^{N-1} (1+r_f)^(k/12) (geometric series). Verify against closed-form for a constant-rfr scenario.
invariants.plausibility_range: hurdle_contributed >= initial_nav for all t >= 0 (Rf-growth and positive contributions are both non-negative)
invariants.realism_requirements: Integration test must exercise at least 12 monthly steps to verify the recurrence accumulates correctly across multiple months.

performance_requirements.notes: Single scalar multiply and add per month-end; O(n) over the full backtest.

features.name: _apply_rebalance GLIDE_PATH trim dispatch
features.description: Add a GLIDE_PATH dispatch branch to the existing _apply_rebalance function in _backtest_steps.py. At each month-end when GLIDE_PATH: (1) compute m = total_val / state.hurdle_contributed; (2) compute target_w = glide_path_target_weight(m, ctx.leaps_fraction, glide_path_config.floor, glide_path_config.half_life_multiple); (3) compute current_leaps_weight = leaps_value / total_val; (4) if current_leaps_weight > target_w + drift_band, trim LEAPS to target_w * total_val using the existing leaps_scale mechanism, redirect proceeds to base at base_target_w. No top-up if current_leaps_weight <= target_w + drift_band (one-sided cap). Reuse the existing leaps_scale dict and partial-close accumulation pattern from the DRIFT path.

invariants.temporal_bounds: All inputs are current-state quantities at the month-end date. No forward values.
invariants.accounting_oracle: After trim: leaps_value_new == target_w * total_val within 1e-6 (when trim fires). Total NAV is conserved: proceeds_to_base + leaps_value_new == leaps_value_old within 1e-6.
invariants.plausibility_range: Post-trim leaps_weight in [floor, w0]; trim fires iff leaps_weight > target_w + drift_band.
invariants.realism_requirements: Integration test must verify trim fires at the correct m threshold and does not fire below the drift band, across a synthetic 25-year backtest equivalent (monthly steps).

performance_requirements.notes: k = number of open LEAPS contracts; typically O(1) since only one active contract exists at a time.

When current_leaps_weight <= target_w + drift_band, state is returned unchanged (no trim).
Trim does NOT fire when m < 1.0 (portfolio underwater): target_w == w0, so current_leaps_weight <= w0 + drift_band is always satisfied at initialization (no spurious trim at startup).

features.name: _apply_gtt_reentry GLIDE_PATH seed adjustment
features.description: Modify _apply_gtt_reentry to seed the fresh LEAPS simulation at the glide-path-adjusted weight when rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH. At the Defensive->Long transition date: compute m_current = total / state.hurdle_contributed; compute seed_weight = glide_path_target_weight(m_current, ctx.leaps_fraction, ...); seed initial_capital = seed_weight * total (replacing the fixed ctx.leaps_fraction * total). Non-GTT and non-GLIDE_PATH paths are unchanged.

invariants.accounting_oracle: seed_weight = glide_path_target_weight(m_current); new_leaps_value + base_holdings == total within 1e-6 post-reentry.
invariants.plausibility_range: seed_weight in [floor, w0]; initial_capital in [floor * total, w0 * total].
invariants.realism_requirements: Integration test must exercise at least one Defensive->Long transition after significant wealth accumulation (m > 1.5) to verify the reduced seed weight is applied correctly.

performance_requirements.notes: Single glide_path_target_weight call plus existing _apply_gtt_reentry logic.

risks.description: hurdle_contributed ordering hazard: if _apply_rebalance reads hurdle_contributed before _apply_contribution has updated it for the current month-end, the NAV multiple m(t) will be computed against the stale prior-month hurdle, causing the trim to fire at the wrong threshold.
risks.mitigation: Enforce in the backtest loop that _apply_contribution (which updates hurdle_contributed) always runs before _apply_rebalance on is_month_end days. Add an explicit assertion or comment in the dispatch order. Verified by the integration test in F-GP-05 / F-GP-06 which checks hurdle matches the analytic recurrence at each trim event.

risks.description: rfr_series NaN regression for non-LEAPS GLIDE_PATH backtests: if _build_context is not modified, rfr_series remains None when use_leaps=False, causing a None-dereference in _apply_contribution when it attempts to read inputs.rfr for the hurdle update.
risks.mitigation: F-GP-04 explicitly gates rfr_series population on rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH regardless of use_leaps. Unit test in F-GP-04 exercises this path directly.

risks.description: DRIFT/QUARTERLY regression: adding GLIDE_PATH dispatch branches to _apply_rebalance and _apply_contribution could silently alter DRIFT/QUARTERLY behavior if a conditional is mis-scoped (e.g. an early return or missing else).
risks.mitigation: All GLIDE_PATH branches are guarded by explicit rebalance_rule == GLIDE_PATH checks. Existing test suite for DRIFT and QUARTERLY must pass without modification (acceptance criterion in F-GP-06). No shared mutable state is modified in the GLIDE_PATH paths.

risks.description: PortfolioState schema extension breaks existing deserialization or copy code: adding hurdle_contributed as a required field (no default) to PortfolioState causes any existing call site that constructs PortfolioState by positional arguments or keyword arguments without this field to raise TypeError.
risks.mitigation: Audit all PortfolioState construction sites in _backtest_steps.py and tests/ before adding the field. Consider defaulting hurdle_contributed=0.0 to avoid breaking non-GLIDE_PATH construction, or provide a default of -1.0 to signal 'unused' explicitly. Alternatively, update all construction sites in the same commit.

risks.description: Semantic confusion between leaps_fraction (fixed target weight for QUARTERLY/DRIFT) and glide-path target weight: code that reads ctx.leaps_fraction as the effective target weight will be incorrect under GLIDE_PATH, where the effective target is time-varying.
risks.mitigation: All GLIDE_PATH trim and reentry paths compute the effective target explicitly via glide_path_target_weight() rather than reading ctx.leaps_fraction as the trim target. The acceptance criteria for F-GP-06 and F-GP-07 include explicit checks that the trim targets match glide_path_target_weight() output, not ctx.leaps_fraction.
